scenarios.name: healthy: liveness=1, timeline=1, high votes -> should NOT be gated
scenarios.expectation: not gated (recommendation reflects the high votes)

scenarios.name: dead liveness: liveness=0 explicit, high votes -> MUST be gated to Skip
scenarios.expectation: gated: liveness (composite zeroed regardless of votes)
scenarios.actual_reason: gated: liveness ≈ 0.000 (a closed gate zeroes the composite regardless of votes)

scenarios.name: dead timeline: timeline=0 explicit, high votes -> MUST be gated to Skip
scenarios.expectation: gated: timeline (composite zeroed regardless of votes)
scenarios.actual_reason: gated: timeline ≈ 0.000 (a closed gate zeroes the composite regardless of votes)

scenarios.name: boundary: liveness exactly at gate_zero (0.05) -> MUST be gated (inclusive <=)
scenarios.expectation: gated (boundary is inclusive, per source: g.factor <= gate_zero)
scenarios.actual_reason: gated: liveness ≈ 0.050 (a closed gate zeroes the composite regardless of votes)

scenarios.name: THE TARGET BUG -- missing liveness field entirely (not 0, just absent), high votes
scenarios.expectation: MISSING liveness must be treated as a CLOSED gate (fail-closed) -- absence of evidence is not evidence of an open gate
scenarios.actual_reason: gated: liveness data MISSING (upstream never verified it) -- treated as closed, not open (fail-closed, per verified-data contract)

scenarios.name: THE TARGET BUG -- missing timeline field entirely (not 0, just absent), high votes
scenarios.expectation: MISSING timeline must be treated as a CLOSED gate (fail-closed)
scenarios.actual_reason: gated: timeline data MISSING (upstream never verified it) -- treated as closed, not open (fail-closed, per verified-data contract)

scenarios.name: BREAK-ATTEMPT FINDING -- out-of-range liveness factor (1.8) must not inflate the composite
scenarios.expectation: gate_product must be clamped to <= 1.0 (an out-of-range factor cannot inflate the composite above what the votes alone justify)
